seo.title: Aifar | Lightweight Standard Collaboration for Government and Enterprise Teams
seo.description: Aifar brings chat, meetings, email, contacts, documents, workflows, and forms into one lightweight collaboration workspace for government and enterprise teams.

home.title: Aifar
home.lead: Lightweight standard collaboration for teams that need clear communication, structured work, and reliable access across desktop and mobile clients.
home.heroAlt: Aifar collaboration workspace preview showing desktop and mobile app screens
home.schemaDescription: Lightweight standard collaboration software for government and enterprise teams.
trust: Micro-lightweight, ready out of the box
home.modulesLead: Aifar covers the daily collaboration layer without forcing teams into a heavy, fragmented toolset.
modules: Organized team messaging for departments, projects, and cross-agency collaboration.
Simple meeting access for distributed teams across desktop, phone, and tablet.
Integrated mail workflows that keep formal communication connected to work context.
Centralized document access for policies, procedures, guides, and shared materials.
home.managedLead: The website is planned as the public entry point for product introduction, downloads, updates, documentation, and technical support.
features: PC, iOS, Android phone, Android pad, and Mac Preview are represented from the first release of the site.
What's New, documentation, support, and download pages are separated so each area can be maintained independently.
Contact forms, support requests, release notes, and documents can later connect to Aifar Forms, Workflow, Docs, Chat, Meeting, Email, and Contact.
updates: Initial public website structure for product introduction, downloads, documentation, support, and contact.
Download area includes a preview channel for the Mac client.
Documentation entry points are ready for user guides, admin guides, deployment notes, and support policies.
home.ctaTitle: Start with a clear website. Grow into a connected Aifar service portal.
home.ctaLead: The first version stays lightweight and deployable. Future versions can connect forms, workflows, documents, contact records, and support conversations directly to Aifar.
